title: Pickleball Thanksgiving Shirt, Gobble Gobble Dink Dink Turkey Pickleball Tee, Funny Fall Gift
description:
A pickleball turkey for the Thanksgiving morning round-robin. Big, readable lettering and a feather fan in warm autumn colours.

Who it's for:
- Players hosting or joining a Thanksgiving pickleball game
- Grandparents and parents who would rather be on the court than in the kitchen (the cooking one)
- Anyone collecting funny fall gifts

About the design:
A pickleball with a face stands in for the turkey, surrounded by a fan of coral, teal and gold feathers with a navy outline. Dark navy lettering for strong contrast on light, earthy garments.

This design was created by our shop with the help of AI design tools and is printed on demand by our production partner.
alt_text: Gobble Gobble Dink Dink design with a pickleball turkey and colourful feathers on a sand tee.
